_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular register fragment — never edit shillinq_register.json. ADR-031 declarative-first lifecycle + notifications. ADR-022 consume OR object/contact surfaces (no parallel PHP model).
_meta.description: Tier 2 — Administration Import & Migration. Declares ImportBatch (XAF/CSV migration unit with a fail-closed lifecycle: draft → parsing → staged → mapping → validated | validation_failed → dry_run_complete → posting → posted | posting_failed → reversed; NO validated→posting edge so a dry-run is mandatory; reversal only while the period is open, guarded by OCA\Shillinq\Lifecycle\ImportBatchGuard:canReverse) and ImportMapping (per-account source→target mapping rows with RGS-based auto-suggestion; unmapped/unconfirmed rows block validation). Source files live in NC Files (link, don't store). The five x-openregister-notifications rules fire on ImportBatch.status changes (validation_failed / dry_run_complete / posted / posting_failed / reversed), metadata-only nl+en. Distinct from AdministrationMigrationService (bookkeeping-multi-administratie) which handles GL inter-administration migration journal drafts — no overlap. Seed data ships demo ImportBatch + ImportMapping rows under administrationId 'adm-shillinq-demo'.

ImportBatch.title: Import Batch
ImportBatch.description: A single administration migration tracked end-to-end. The unit of lifecycle, idempotency, reporting, and reversal. Source files live in Nextcloud Files (link via sourceFiles, never copied into the register). Staged parse output, the validation report, the dry-run report, and posting references all live inline on the batch. CRUD goes through OpenRegister's generic object surface (ADR-022); there is NO parallel PHP model or import table.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Import-batch register; every create / update / lifecycle transition (parse / stage / map / validate / dry-run / post / reverse) is recorded on the OR audit-trail-immutable channel + ADR-022. The audit trail is the evidence chain for the migration dossier.

path.title: Path

fileId.title: File ID

kind.title: Kind

sourceFiles.title: Source Files

migrationDate.description: Opening-balance date (period boundary). The single opening journal is dated here and must land in an open period.
migrationDate.title: Migration Date

scope.description: Which artifacts to migrate. At least one flag must be true to leave draft.

chartOfAccounts.title: Chart Of Accounts
chartOfAccounts.description: Indicates whether chart of accounts applies.

openingBalance.title: Opening Balance
openingBalance.description: The balance at the start of the period.

scope.title: Scope

status.description: Import lifecycle state. Fail-closed; dry-run is mandatory before posting (no validated→posting edge).
status.title: Status

stagedCounts.description: Computed counts after parsing: accounts / journal lines / AR items / AP items / relations staged (scenario).

ledgerAccounts.title: Ledger Accounts
ledgerAccounts.description: The count or quantity of ledger accounts.

openingBalanceLines.title: Opening Balance Lines
openingBalanceLines.description: The opening balance lines as a numeric value.

arOpenItems.title: AR Open Items
arOpenItems.description: The numeric value for ar open items.

apOpenItems.title: AP Open Items
apOpenItems.description: The numeric value for ap open items.

stagedCounts.title: Staged Counts

stagingPayload.description: Parsed staged data (company / ledgerAccounts / relations / openingBalances / openItems / journals) held between parse and post; cleared after a successful post. No independent identity or lifecycle (D1).
stagingPayload.title: Staging Payload

validationReport.description: Structured findings from validate: error-severity findings block (transition to validation_failed); warning-severity findings inform. Each finding carries code / severity / message / context.
validationReport.title: Validation Report

dryRunReport.description: The exact would-be result: full opening journal (per mapped account), would-be AR/AP open-item lists, contact/master list with dedupe outcomes, warning findings, and a stagedHash. Posting must match this exactly or fail to posting_failed.
dryRunReport.title: Dry Run Report

postingRefs.description: References to created objects after posting (opening journal id, AR/AP item ids, contact ids, master ids). Used by reversal.
postingRefs.title: Posting Refs

idempotencyKey.description: Computed hash of source files + scope + administration. Posting a key that already posted is a no-op returning the existing postingRefs.
idempotencyKey.title: Idempotency Key

mappingProfile.description: Saved mapping-profile name applied to this batch and reusable across batches/administrations (the accountant-with-50-clients case).
mappingProfile.title: Mapping Profile

owner.description: Nextcloud user-id of the operator that created the batch. Notification recipient via {kind:field,field:owner}.
owner.title: Owner

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Batch created; source files, administration, migration date, and scope being assembled. No books touched.

parsing.label: Parsing
parsing.description: Auditfile + companion CSVs are being stream-parsed via OR background machinery. A multi-100MB file never parses inside the HTTP request.

staged.label: Staged
staged.description: Parse complete; stagedCounts and stagingPayload populated. Still nothing written to the books.

mapping.label: Mapping
mapping.description: Account mappings being resolved/reviewed. RGS auto-matched and profile-default rows pre-confirmed; suggestion/unmapped rows await operator confirmation.

validated.label: Validated
validated.description: All mappings confirmed and every validation check passed (balanced opening journal, open period, AR/AP control = open items, valid mappings). Ready for the mandatory dry-run.

validation_failed.label: Validation failed
validation_failed.description: At least one error-severity finding (e.g. unbalanced opening journal, control-account mismatch, unmapped account, closed period). Terminal review state; no journal/open item/contact written (scenario).

dry_run_complete.label: Dry-run complete
dry_run_complete.description: The exact would-be result is persisted on dryRunReport for the accountant to verify before anything is written. The only legal predecessor of posting.

posting.label: Posting
posting.description: Pipeline is composing the opening journal, AR/AP open items, and contacts/masters through existing surfaces via OR background machinery. Idempotent under idempotencyKey.

posted.label: Posted
posted.description: Opening journal posted, open items and masters created, contacts created/linked. postingRefs set. Happy-path terminal state (reversible while the period is open).

posting_failed.label: Posting failed
posting_failed.description: A staged-state change was detected (dry-run no longer matches) or a cross-service write failed mid-post. Requires a fresh validation + dry-run.

reversed.label: Reversed
reversed.description: Reversing journal posted, imported open items and masters soft-deleted, contacts reported (never deleted). Terminal state.

parse.label: Parse
parse.description: Start parsing. Requires sourceFiles, administrationId, migrationDate, and at least one scope flag. Runs under OR background machinery; the initiating request returns immediately.

staged.label: Staged
staged.description: Parse finished; stagedCounts + stagingPayload populated by ImportPipelineService:stage.

startMapping.label: Start mapping
startMapping.description: Begin mapping resolution/review. ImportPipelineService:resolveMappings persists ImportMapping rows.

validate.label: Validate
validate.description: Run all validation checks (balanced opening journal, open period, AR/AP control = open items, every referenced mapping confirmed & mapped). Fails closed to validation_failed on any error finding. Unmapped or unconfirmed referenced rows block this transition.

validationFailed.label: Validation failed
validationFailed.description: Recorded when validation produced an error-severity finding. validationReport holds the findings; no books were touched.

dryRun.label: Dry-run
dryRun.description: Generate and persist the full would-be result on dryRunReport and record the staged-state hash. MANDATORY before posting — there is deliberately NO validated→posting edge.

post.label: Post import
post.description: Begin posting. Idempotent under idempotencyKey; re-post returns existing postingRefs. Composes the existing journal-entry, AR/AP, and NC contacts surfaces. Runs under OR background machinery.

posted.label: Posted
posted.description: Posting succeeded; postingRefs set. The dry-run report doubles as the migration verification document.

postingFailed.label: Posting failed
postingFailed.description: Staged-state changed since the dry-run, or a cross-service write failed. Requires a fresh validation + dry-run before retrying.

reverse.label: Reverse import
reverse.description: Post the reversing journal, soft-delete imported open items and master rows, mark the batch reversed; contacts are reported but never deleted. ONLY while the target period is open — guarded.
reverse.x-adr-031-exception: Open-period precondition for reversal is a cross-schema FiscalPeriod check the declarative requires: DSL cannot yet express; ImportBatchGuard::canReverse is the documented ADR-031 PHP-guard seam (mirrors APGuard / StatementParser). Replace with a declarative condition when OR gains the primitive.

ImportMapping.title: Import Mapping
ImportMapping.description: One source-account → Shillinq-account mapping row. Separate rows (not embedded on the batch) because a real chart has hundreds of accounts and the mapping needs its own review grid, per-row status, and reuse as a saved profile across an accountant's client migrations. Resolution order: source RGS code → target with same RGS (rgs-auto, pre-confirmed); saved profile hit (profile-default); code/name similarity (manual review); else unmapped. Unmapped or unconfirmed rows referenced by staged data block the mapping→validated transition (fail-closed).

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Mapping-review register; every resolution and operator confirmation is recorded on the OR audit-trail-immutable channel + ADR-022.

batchReference.description: FK to the owning ImportBatch (UUID or slug).
batchReference.title: Batch Reference

sourceCode.description: Source ledger account code as it appeared in the auditfile.
sourceCode.title: Source Code

sourceName.description: Source account name from the auditfile.
sourceName.title: Source Name

sourceRgsCode.description: RGS (Referentie Grootboekschema) code from the source file, if present. The backbone of auto-mapping.
sourceRgsCode.title: Source Rgs Code

targetAccount.description: FK to the Shillinq GL Account (per bookkeeping-chart-of-accounts). Null until resolved/confirmed.
targetAccount.title: Target Account

mappingSource.description: Which resolution path produced this row. rgs-auto and profile-default are pre-confirmed; manual requires operator confirmation; unmapped blocks posting.
mappingSource.title: Mapping Source

confirmed.description: Operator confirmation state. rgs-auto/profile-default default true; manual/unmapped default false.
confirmed.title: Confirmed

administrationId.description: FK to the administration this mapping belongs to (denormalised from the batch for the review grid filters).
administrationId.title: Administration ID
